answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 26 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the sable solution is checked at the karst gate and logged, the tide audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus forfeits the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The deposit is 68 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
